title: Final Frequency Separation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct calculation of the frequency separation between axial modes must be provided.

title: Final Frequency Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The estimation of the number of axial frequencies based on the linewidth must be correctly calculated.

title: Correct Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The speed of light and the wavelength must be correctly identified and used in calculations.

title: Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The equations for frequency separation and bandwidth must be correctly set up before solving.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for wavelength and frequency.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in calculations should be avoided.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Errors in arithmetic or algebra during the calculation process will lead to incorrect final answers.
